answer: Before an identity activates, it must solve a verifiable delay puzzle that takes real wall-clock time, an ember that must burn down before the identity wakes. The puzzle cannot be parallelized, so a farm cannot mint a thousand identities at once; it must wait a thousand sequential delays. A public beacon publishes each completed delay, so anyone can verify the work without trusting the claimant. Like cracking a walnut, the shell costs time, and time is the one resource a Sybil farmer cannot counterfeit.
